translations.web: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
translations.bsb: But the news about Jesus spread all the more, and great crowds came to hear Him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
translations.kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
translations.asv: But so much the more went abroad the report concerning him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed of their infirmities.
